main_text.p: consecrare. Si quid igitur pec-catum est, quod vobis tantis viris hæc tenuia offero, spero me veniam impetraturū apud vos, qui haud minus læta fronte exi-gua ab infimis, quam magna à summis soleatis accipere. Patia-mini igitur hunc libellum nomi-nis vestri splendore decoratum illustrioremq; factum ad manus hominum peruenire. Ego vicis-sim omni obseruantiæ officio-rūq; genere vestro nomini, lau-di &honori studebo. FaxitDeus, vt vestra dignitas literis sit orna-mento, &literatis præsidio quam diutissime. Marp. è Museo meo, MDC. XII. 15. Octob.

page.notes: Scan is a single page with a marbled edge; a faint show-through of text from the reverse appears in the lower half and is omitted. Line-end hyphens are printed. The word "confecrare" is printed with a long s in the head of the text; read as "consecrare" (the first letter is partly damaged). The word "Patia-" carries a faint pen-like mark near "accipere" which is not printed text.
